question: Will Bitcoin drop below $66,000 at any point after Aug 19,2026, 17:00 UTC and before Aug 20, 2026, 23:59 UTC?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if any 1-minute candle low on Binance BTC/USDT spot is at or below $66,000 at any point strictly after Aug 19, 2026, 17:00 UTC and before Aug 20, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
- "No": Wins if no 1-minute candle low on Binance BTC/USDT spot falls at or below $66,000 at any point strictly after Aug 19, 2026, 17:00 UTC and before Aug 20, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
